title: Abbas ke matamdaar hai hum
body:
abbas ke matamdaar hai'n ham
deti hai dua zehra ham ko
saqqa-e-haram ke ghamkhwaro
saqqe ka matam karte raho
<<DIVIDER>>
pehchaan hamari matam hai
jab tak bhi seeno'n mai dam hai
is matam se duniya bhar mai
paighaam-e-hussaini phonchado
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha ye betou'nn se
kal jaan luta dena hai tumhe
khaiber ki ohad ki khandaq ki phir yaad dilaado shehzaado
kehte the sakina se abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
bhujh jayegi bibi sabki pyaas
mai dariya utha leaaunga
baba se ijazat dilwaado
sajjad ki halat kya hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
kaanto'n pa chala aur aah na ki
bimaar ke zakhmi talwou'n par
qurbaan zamane ko kardo
ayyam hai sheh ki ruqsat ke
<<DIVIDER>>
barsao lahu ab aankho'n se
ji bhar ke karo matam sheh ka
zehra ko vidayi pursa do
